call_points.text: PVDF project final commissioning is underway and on track for Q3 FY27 capitalization.
Fluorochemicals growth was driven by higher HFC volumes and improved realizations, offsetting US weakness.
Capacitor-grade film is scaling up with key customer approvals secured and commercial sales progressing.
Commercial sales of aluminium foil for capacitors are expected to commence from Q3 FY27.
Next-gen HFO refrigerants project received environmental clearance and remains on track for Q4 FY28 capitalization.
EHF project site work is underway, targeting capitalization in Q3 FY28 for semiconductor wafer cleaning.
Aseptic packaging foil qualification with global leaders like Tetra Pak established new value-added revenue streams.
Belting fabrics achieved record performance in Q2, driven by strong export traction and customer additions.

operating_notes.text: SRF indefinitely delayed its ₹490 Cr BOPP film project at Indore.
SRF approved ₹88 Cr capex for HFC capacity expansion to utilise HCFC-22 production allowance
SRF approved enhanced capex of ₹2,285 Cr for HFOs and AHF plants at Gopalpur, Odisha
First phase of Capacitor Grade BOPP Film line at Indore commissioned at ₹277 Cr.
Outstanding listed commercial papers stood at ₹700 Cr as on September 30, 2026.
Q2FY27 Performance Films & Foil business achieved its highest-ever packed production of films.
As of September 30, 2026, SRF had filed 539 patent applications and been granted 160 patents globally.
SRF has 16 manufacturing facilities—13 in India and one each in Thailand, South Africa and Hungary.
Refrigerant demand and pricing expected to remain stable despite seasonality, with higher volumes from new markets offsetting softer US demand.
Aseptic packaging qualification achieved with global leader Tetra Pak for aluminium foil.

timeline.summary: SRF received a favorable CESTAT order quashing a ₹0.37 Cr CGST penalty originally imposed by authorities in Gwalior.
Arun Bhart Ram, Ashish Bharat Ram, Kartik Bharat Ram declared no encumbrance on SRF Limited shares for FY2026 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) on 2026-04-01.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹4,615.17 Cr (+7.0% YoY), net profit ₹582.02 Cr (+10.6% YoY).
SRF approved an indefinite delay for its ₹490 Cr BOPP Film project at Indore due to changes in the operating environment.
2026-05-05: SRF Board approved ₹88 Cr capex for HFC capacity expansion to utilise HCFC-22 production allowance
2026-05-05: SRF Board approved enhanced capex of ₹2,285 Cr for 20k MTPA HFOs and 30k MTPA AHF plants at Gopalpur, Odisha, with completion by February 28, 2028
SRF Limited shared the audio recording of its earnings call on 06.05.2026 discussing audited Q4FY26 and FY26 results, available at srf.com.
2026-05-12: SRF Limited informed the exchange about the availability of the transcript of its earnings call held on 06 May 2026.
SRF commissioned the first phase of its Indore Capacitor Grade BOPP Film plant at ₹277 Cr on 15.05.2026.

KAMA Holdings Limited’s promoter group, including **Arun Bharat Ram**, **Ashish Bharat Ram**, and **Kartik Bharat Ram**, declared no encumbrance on SRF Limited’s shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026.
SRF filed transcript of Q1FY27 earnings call held on 23 July 2026
SRF reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹4,904 Cr and approved a ₹600 Cr capex for 12,000 MTPA battery foil capacity.
2026-10-21: Board approved ₹600 Cr capex for 12,000 MTPA battery foil plant at Jetapur
SRF presented Q2FY27 results showing 35% revenue growth to ₹4,904 Cr and confirmed project milestones across PVDF, foil and HFO refrigerants.
SRF Limited shared the audio recording of its earnings call on October 22, 2026, discussing unaudited Q2 & H1 FY2027 results via its website.
